sql: SELECT a.analyst_name, COUNT(*) AS decided FROM caseflow.cases c JOIN caseflow.analysts a ON a.analyst_id = c.analyst_id WHERE c.status IN ('approved', 'declined') AND c.decided_at >= DATE '2026-10-01' AND c.decided_at < DATE '2026-11-01' GROUP BY a.analyst_name ORDER BY decided DESC
explanation: Approved or declined applications in October 2026, by the analyst who decided them.
